source.license_basis: NASA explicit us-pd; DATA_SET_ID must match each PDS label.
source.wavelength_method_evidence: Clegg2017 wavelength calibration section: Ti baseline wavelength-channel map uses known vacuum lines and spectra are resampled to that map. Gasda2021 sections2.1/2.3.1 identify the same LANL testbed and Ti calibration before each laboratory sample run, citing Clegg2017. CALINFO links calib_2015 and calib_2021 to those methods. Medium is based on this method chain, not chamber pressure.
source.composition_evidence: Clegg2017 standard provenance: independent XRF/dry combustion or certified values; missing values are not zero. Gasda2021 section2.2: commercial reference standards or independent ACTLabs fusion ICP-MS. Values are published assay estimates, not certified per-cell upper bounds.

uncertainty.weighting: Each physical sample has unit weight; average its replicate detections.
uncertainty.null_interval_policy: <2 supporting clusters, <100 valid draws or degenerate draws

limitations: Unknown labels are excluded, never counted as negatives.
Precision is conditional on known labels and requires positive and negative support.
Intervals condition on sampled clusters and fixed fitted models; not simultaneous.
A zero observed false-positive count is not proof of a zero population rate.
Operational below-threshold labels do not establish elemental absence.
